activities.title: IP Configuration Troubleshooting
activities.description: Compare two PCs, investigate IPv4 configuration with simulated command prompts, and apply a fix supported by your evidence.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices IPv4 addressing, DHCP, DNS, and connectivity diagnosis in a two-PC network.

activities.title: Motherboard Assembly
activities.description: Install desktop components, configure a matched memory pair, and connect the motherboard, graphics card, and SATA drive.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.

activities.title: Network Setup & Cabling
activities.description: Build a small network by selecting appropriate devices, media, connectors, and cabling choices for the scenario.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices network-device roles, media selection, connectors, and Ethernet termination.

activities.title: Ports & Protocols
activities.description: Choose services and ports for support tickets, classify transport behavior, match protocols to their purpose, and diagnose multi-part networking problems. Practice covers the A+ Core 1 220-1201 port set.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices common service ports and transport behavior using the existing Core 1 activity scope.

activities.title: Power Protection & UPS
activities.description: Inspect a small-office work order, connect power-protection equipment, and test what happens when utility power fails.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.

activities.title: Printer Troubleshooting
activities.description: Inspect printer components and symptoms, then diagnose common laser and inkjet printer problems.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.

activities.title: RAID Drive Replacement
activities.description: Inspect a RAID storage system, identify the affected drive, and choose an appropriate replacement based on the array and drive details.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.

activities.title: SOHO Physical Installation
activities.description: Build a physical Internet connection from the service outlet to the local network. Recognize equipment and connector shapes, place the equipment, connect each cable to two ports, and practice current Core 1 network tools through job matching and tool-function questions.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices Internet handoffs, WAN/LAN connections, physical media, and network-tool selection.

activities.title: SOHO Router Configuration
activities.description: Configure a small office/home office router from a work order. Practice LAN addressing, DHCP, employee Wi-Fi, guest Wi-Fi, wireless bands, channels, and security settings.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices LAN addressing, DHCP, wireless channels, and small-office wireless configuration.

activities.title: TCP/IP Packet Walk
activities.description: Follow data from a client to a network service and identify what happens as the traffic moves through the network.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices traffic flow, network-device roles, encapsulation, and decapsulation.

activities.title: Two-Site VoIP Troubleshooting
activities.description: Compare two office networks, investigate call-quality symptoms with simulated terminals, and apply a repair supported by your evidence.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices interpreting latency, jitter, loss, bandwidth, and QoS in simulated network diagnostics.

activities.title: Wireless Coverage
activities.description: Troubleshoot a weak, intermittent Wi-Fi connection in a 3,000-square-foot office. Inspect the floor plan and reposition available equipment to improve service across the workspace.

certificationAssociations.reason: Retains the existing A+ Core 1 certification assignment.
Practices access point placement, interference, and wireless connectivity troubleshooting.

activities.title: Network Configuration Concepts
activities.description: Configure three network diagrams using IPv4 addresses, LAN and screened-subnet placement, service ports, Wi-Fi security, NAT, and port forwarding.

certificationAssociations.reason: Practices client network configuration, secure wireless access, and basic network access decisions for A+ Core 2.

activities.title: Windows Help Desk: Troubleshooting Multiple PCs
activities.description: Investigate four Windows workstations with simulated commands, interpret diagnostic evidence, and recommend network, share, policy, and integrity repairs.

certificationAssociations.reason: Practices Windows command-line diagnostics and troubleshooting of client networking, mapped resources, Group Policy, protected system files, and file-system integrity for A+ Core 2.

activities.title: Windows Startup Recovery
activities.description: Recover UEFI/GPT and BIOS/MBR startup failures through interactive Windows recovery screens, firmware settings, and simulated boot-repair commands.

certificationAssociations.reason: Practices Windows startup troubleshooting, recovery-tool selection, boot configuration, command-line repair, and verification for A+ Core 2.

activities.title: Windows BSOD and Application Troubleshooting
activities.description: Investigate driver and memory stop errors and application failures using interactive Windows tools, perform evidence-based repairs, and verify recovery.

certificationAssociations.reason: Practices Windows stop-error, driver, memory, and application troubleshooting through diagnostic evidence, appropriate remediation, and verification.

activities.title: Phishing Email Investigation
activities.description: Investigate a simulated corporate inbox, inspect message evidence, distinguish legitimate mail from spam and phishing, and choose safe responses.

certificationAssociations.reason: Practices antiphishing awareness, social engineering recognition, business email compromise, and safe email handling for Core 2 Security objectives 2.4 and 2.5.

activities.title: Malware Investigation & Remediation
activities.description: Investigate Windows security incidents, identify malware indicators, contain threats, perform remediation, and verify system recovery using interactive troubleshooting tools.

certificationAssociations.reason: Practices malware investigation, risk-based containment, remediation, escalation, verification, and incident documentation for Core 2 objective 2.6 and supporting Windows/security troubleshooting concepts.

activities.title: Help Desk Ticket Triage & Resolution PBQ
activities.description: Review help desk incidents, prioritize tickets, interpret evidence, diagnose issues, and select appropriate corrective actions in a simulated service desk.

certificationAssociations.reason: Practices ticket review, impact and urgency assessment, escalation, and documentation for Core 2 objective 4.1 with supporting Windows, networking, and security troubleshooting.
